messages:
anya: Nightly evals flagged a regression on the q4_0 quantized Llama-13B profile. MRR@10 down ~6% on evalset-bench1 vs yesterday. This is blocking the 1.9 rollout. cc @matt @sophie

matt: Ugh. Which change landed overnight? any obvious infra/runner diffs? :eyes:

sophie: I saw a runtime/runner change merged last night: batch scheduling tweak to favor larger batches (sha abc1234). Could affect batching order & KV cache timings.

anya: Yep, that was my suspicion. I kicked off a quick bisect on the eval harness. Will update when I have a narrowed commit.

raj: If it's scheduling we might see nondet outputs due to prefix caching timing. Did the quant kernels change too?

anya: No quant kernels touched. Only runner scheduling + small perf flag. Quick log from the failing job:
```
EVAL: evalset-bench1/model=llama-13b-q4_0
METRIC MRR@10: baseline 0.670 -> 0.629 (drop 0.041)
trace: bert_sim scores lower across 3 shards
```

matt: Can you paste the git bisect steps you used? I'll run local repro.

anya: Doing binary search between good=def5678 and bad=gh0jk90. Steps:
```
git bisect start gh0jk90 def5678
# run harness runner smoke, reproduce metric drop
# bisect points to abc1234
git bisect good def5678
git bisect bad gh0jk90
git bisect run ./tools/eval_harness/run_smoke.sh
```
Result: first bad commit is abc1234 (runtime/runner: prefer-large-batches).

sophie: Nice bisect. Does switching the scheduling back to the old policy fix the eval?

anya: Quick patch toggling the env var SCHED_POLICY=legacy in the canary container brought MRR back to 0.672 on the same harness run.

raj: That strongly points to scheduling reorder changing KV cache warmup/sequence alignment, which hurts quant outputs.

matt: For release blockers we have two options: revert abc1234, or ship a hotfix that gates the policy behind config and defaults to legacy for quantized models. Revert is fastest.

eva: infra-bot: created ticket RW-1429 "regression: runner scheduling impacts quantized evals" and added blocker label. Assigned to @matt. :bug:

matt: I'll open the revert PR now and include the gated config approach as a follow-up. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/runtime/pull/284/revert-abc1234

anya: Can we run the full eval suite on that revert in staging? I want the nightly to pass before we unblock 1.9.

infra-bot: Deployed revert PR to staging canary. Job: staging-eval-1794006890.

anya: Re-run finished — staging full-suite shows metrics back to baseline within noise. MRR@10 now 0.671.

sophie: Great. Matt, please coordinate the rollback and then we can plan a proper fix that preserves perf but keeps determinism for quant models.

matt: Will do. Rolling back from prod clouds now and will cut a follow-up RFC for scheduling semantics + explicit model-type overrides. ETA 1.5h. :hammer:
